alive.last_commit_message:
fix(agent-scan,mcp-scan): honor finish tool name casing (#760)

Compare the finish tool name case-insensitively in agent-scan and mcp-scan so <function=Finish>/FINISH/fInIsH actually ends the agent loop instead of re-triggering a model call.

The tool registries already accept case variants, but the termination checks compared against lowercase only, so an uppercase/odd-cased finish executed as an ordinary tool and the scanner requested another response.

Local verification: agent-scan and mcp-scan new finish-case tests pass (5+5); full go test ./... on main baseline shows no regression. CI green.

Co-authored-by: Elon-Jiang <Elon-Jiang@users.noreply.github.com>
